name: Leg Extension
steps: Adjust the seat so knees line up with the machine pivot and the roller sits above the ankles.
Sit back against the pad and hold the handles.
Straighten the knees smoothly without snapping them.
Lower the roller slowly to the starting position.
cues: Use a controlled range and even effort from both legs.
mistakes: Lifting the hips to move the weight.
breathing: Exhale as you extend; inhale as you lower.
